name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core table), descriptor reflects purpose (per-slot horizontal x-offset) and data type (table). '8slot' is the domain dimension (8 directional aura slots), not a Ghidra address residue; no hex address suffix present. Accurately matches the verified content and use.
purpose: Const table of 8 per-slot horizontal x-offsets for the 8-directional summon-spell aura sprite ring.
logic_summary: Read-only .rodata table; values { -59, -39, 0, 39, 55, 39, 0, -39 } (signed int32). Sole reader fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring @ 0x262EF MOVSD-copies all 8 entries into a stack-local int[8], then for the enemy team (runtime_char[caster].bTeam==0) adds 0x94 to each local slot, and forms each sprite x position as row_multiplier[slot]*row_stride + x_offset[slot] + 0x50 + origin_y. Negative entries shift those slots left. The renderer mutates only its local copy, never this table.
element_semantics: Each element is a signed int32 horizontal pixel x-offset for one of the 8 directional aura-ring slots; added (after an optional per-team +0x94 baseline shift applied to the local copy) to the sprite blit destination x.
notes: Verified: Ghidra DT int[8] LEN=32 at 0x52420; read_memory bytes c5ffffff d9ffffff 00000000 27000000 37000000 27000000 00000000 d9ffffff = { -59,-39,0,39,55,39,0,-39 } byte-identical to src definition. xrefs_to = only fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring (READ @0x26318, DATA @0x26313); zero game-side writers confirms const. src comment block (btltab.c lines 631-654) already accurate/precise/ASCII -> keep. Ghidra plate was null -> created concise plate reflecting src conclusion (data plate via run_script_inline setComment(PLATE_COMMENT)). No logic changed; no rename applied (Stage 2).
